nom: COSRX Skin Barrier Moisturizing Cream For Face & Body

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including chronically dry arms, elbows, feet and hands, report the cream relieves flaking, scaly patches and dry bumps and keeps skin soft for hours, though one reviewer with dry skin still found it left her face dry even with serums underneath.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe sensitive skin report no irritation or allergic reaction and call it gentle enough for when skin needs a break from actives, with one noting it doesn't irritate despite being cautious with new products.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her late 60s with very dry, mature skin in a desert climate reports it restores softness and elasticity and outperforms other ceramide creams she has tried.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe lasting hydration (up to 24 hours for some) that leaves skin soft and supple; one reviewer nonetheless says it left her face dry even under serums, and another feels it may not be moisturizing enough for winter.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe it as repairing and supporting the skin barrier, useful as a 'basics only' product when skin needs a break, with one long-term user reporting healing of old dermatitis-scarred skin on the elbow.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer who normally breaks out with rich moisturizers reports no issues over several days of facial use; another with normal-to-combination skin reports no breakouts using it on the body.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports dry bumps on her arms almost completely disappearing after a few days of use, and another reports a cream mask/massage use smoothed out bumps.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the cream doesn't make her face too oily and doesn't leave a greasy residue, and another with oily-prone T-zone found it hydrating without triggering sebum overproduction overnight.

aspects.libelle: Large tub, good value for amount
Too light for very dry winter skin

extraits.texte: For the amount of product you're receiving for the price is not bad , good on the body but left my face dry even after serums still left my skin so dry
I loved this moisturizer. My skin can get very dry and can sometimes be sensitive to certain products. This was non greasy and did not irritate my skin. Moisturized well.

I had tried everything short of removing my skin to get rid of stubborn, scaly patches on my legs and nothing worked. It was so embarrassing!! After using this for just one week, scales that had been there for decades and survived countless useless products were completely gone. This is the first product that actually delivered real, visible results, and I'm honestly blown away

I'm honestly so impressed with this cream! From the very first use, my skin felt deeply nourished, soft, and calm. It has that perfect balance—rich enough to really support my skin barrier, but not heavy or greasy. I love how quickly it absorbs and leaves my skin feeling plump, hydrated, and smooth all day. If you struggle with sensitivity, dryness, or just want to keep your skin barrier healthy, this is such a reliable go-to. It's one of those products where you can feel the difference right away—my skin just felt comforted and stronger. Definitely a new staple in my routine! 🌿💧

I have reviewed this 8/5/25 and give a 3 star. I have been using this ceramide jar for 22 days now. My right elbow( had scars from dermatitis -8 years ago using harsh prescription cream and from scratching) feels so soft and moist. I did not encounter skin allergy. I am very careful with skin products due to sensitive skin. I am happy with the product and will give this moisturizer 5 stars.

extraits.titre: I love COSRX Skin Barrier Moisturizing Cream
extraits.texte: I love COSRX Skin Barrier Moisturizing Cream. I have very dry arms with little dry bumps. I use this cream daily and in a few days the dry bumps were almost completely gone!! I love that it does not have a strong scent and the cream is thick but does not leave you feeling grease. Another winner from COSRX.

extraits.titre: The BEST Ceremide Barrier Cream On The Planet
extraits.texte: For a true and honest review I waited several days to comment. This is the Holy Grail all over moisturizer. Im 67 and live in the Arizona desert, my skin is very dry and needs constant moisturizing. This ceremide barrier cream beats all others hands down due its high quality ingredients. It absorbs quickly, moisturizes all through the day leaving my skin so soft and bringing back elasticity. I like that you can use it on your face along with your body. The amount of product you get in this tub along with the small amount you need to apply will last for a long time and is absolutely worth it. Trust me, you wont find a better ceremide cream than this one from COSRX.
